title: 长任务日志与会话历史必须有边界
summary: 媒体运行时的 session history、completion callbacks 和重定向日志可能在长任务中持续持有对象与内存。需要把正式任务的统计可观测性与无限日志/会话保留分离。
proposed_invariants: Session history has a deliberate small bound.
Short self-tests/diagnostics may use verbose logs; long formal jobs use a lower active log level while retaining essential statistics.
Completed session objects are cleared after extracting required failure/provenance summaries.
Formal callbacks are owned by the long-lived job service and do not capture Activity/WebView objects.
note: Repository search located the policy but not a confirmed implementation; keep Candidate.
